summary: Add address-pr-feedback skill with mandatory reply+resolve per-thread loop and zero-unresolved re-query done gate; point babysit guidance at the skill and document sanctioned GraphQL fallback (#1155).
migration_impact: Downstream repos receive the skill via plugin/bootstrap. Agents addressing PR feedback must reply in-thread, resolve each thread, and re-query until zero unresolved remain (except need:human-review escalations).
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / re-import plugin payload so `plugin/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md` is present.
2. When addressing review feedback, read and follow the address-pr-feedback skill before declaring done.
3. Prefer plate_resolve_review_thread / gh plate pr babysit --act; use the skill's gh api graphql fallback only when helpers are unavailable.
agent_notes: Address feedback is not complete until a re-query of reviewThreads shows zero unresolved threads (excluding explicit human escalations with need:human-review). Every thread gets an in-thread reply (commit SHA or decline reason) before resolveReviewThread. See plugin/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md babysit step 7.
